editorial:
If you loved the TV show, this movie feels like catching up with old friends. Carrie, Charlotte, Miranda, and Samantha are back, and the story picks up right where the series left off. Carrie and Big are finally taking the next big step, but things go sideways fast. The girls rally around her, and you get to watch them navigate love, heartbreak, and friendship all over again. The fashion is still front and center, the New York City backdrop looks gorgeous, and the humor lands well. It is a long movie, but fans will not mind spending extra time with these characters.

The acting is solid across the board, especially Sarah Jessica Parker, who carries the emotional weight of the story. The pacing drags a little in the middle, and some side plots feel rushed. Still, the heart of the film is the friendship between these four women, and that shines through. If you are a fan of the show or love romantic comedies with strong female leads, this is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: After Carrie and Big's wedding falls apart, she spends months heartbroken and alone. Eventually, Big realizes his mistake and tries to win her back. In the final scenes, he sends her love letters and shows up at her apartment. They reconcile and have a small, private wedding with just the girls present. The movie ends with Carrie happy and surrounded by her best friends, proving that love and friendship can survive even the biggest setbacks.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with strong female friendships.
